migration_and_rollback.projection_note: The change is confined to the existing public Boolean compatibility projector and the existing relation-retention regression owner. Reverting commits f843380d721f960f2e6d17475807d967df70197a and 2454d6e60113f45f1099d01ede20714ae4a91f20 restores the previous compatibility behavior without changing the canonical compiler, rewriting history, or introducing a parallel projection path.

title: Align strict Boolean cross-plane admission with verified Fourfold authority

masterplan.active_delivery_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

result.summary: The public strict Boolean compatibility projector now treats matching raw cross-plane ForestEdge records only as fail-closed admission/consistency inputs, matching the canonical compile_relation_blocks trust boundary: a directed raw cross-plane edge cannot manufacture a relation row and requires the exact verified Fourfold binding; a matching undirected cross-plane edge refuses instead of acquiring invented orientation. Verified FourfoldSnapshot.bindings remain the sole cross-plane fact authority.
result.structural_change: One existing compatibility path now enforces the same cross-plane authority boundary already enforced by the canonical multi-relation compiler; no new fact source is introduced.
result.gardener: No helper, compiler, verifier, cache, adapter family, graph authority, fact store, backend, registry, public API, or test module was added. The focused equivalence regression was added to the existing relation-retention test owner.

implementation.test_strategy: Construct an exact Forest/Fourfold pair containing one directed code-to-knowledge ForestEdge while intentionally omitting the verified binding, then prove both the strict Boolean projector and canonical compiler fail closed rather than producing a row from raw Forest evidence. Existing cross-plane positive tests retain verified-binding projection behavior.
